sentences.en: Last Sunday, I went to see my friend Tom.
sentences.zh: 上周日，我去看望我的朋友汤姆。

sentences.en: His house was near the park.
sentences.zh: 他的家在公园附近。

sentences.en: I rang the bell.
sentences.zh: 我按了门铃。

sentences.en: He opened the door with a smile.
sentences.zh: 他微笑着开了门。

sentences.en: He took me to his room and we sat on the floor.
sentences.zh: 他带我去他的房间，我们坐在地板上。

sentences.en: Tom had a new game and we played it together.
sentences.zh: 汤姆有一个新游戏，我们一起玩了。

sentences.en: His mother gave us cups of tea and some cake.
sentences.zh: 他妈妈给了我们几杯茶和一些蛋糕。

sentences.en: We talked about our school and our friends.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了我们的学校和我们的朋友。

sentences.en: I saw a picture of his family on the wall.
sentences.zh: 我看到墙上有一张他家人的照片。

sentences.en: Tom is a good friend.
sentences.zh: 汤姆是个好朋友。

sentences.en: He is kind and wise.
sentences.zh: 他又善良又聪明。

sentences.en: I was happy to be with him.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴和他在一起。

sentences.en: The afternoon was better than I had hoped.
sentences.zh: 那个下午比我希望的还要好。

sentences.en: His behavior was kind and polite.
sentences.zh: 他的行为友善而有礼貌。

sentences.en: We had a good relation with each other.
sentences.zh: 我们彼此之间关系很好。

sentences.en: He had a great sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 他很有幽默感。

sentences.en: I had a feeling of pleasure when I was with him.
sentences.zh: 和他在一起时我有一种愉悦的感觉。

sentences.en: His father worked for the town council.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲在镇议会工作。

sentences.en: I made a request for help with my work.
sentences.zh: 我请求帮助我的工作。

sentences.en: He made a suggestion about where to go.
sentences.zh: 他就去哪里提出了建议。

sentences.en: The agreement between us was clear.
sentences.zh: 我们之间的协议很清楚。

sentences.en: An argument is not a good way to talk.
sentences.zh: 争论不是好的谈话方式。

sentences.en: Her approval of the plan made me happy.
sentences.zh: 她对计划的同意让我很高兴。
